description: Buyer-side demo agent for NeuralClear for Trusted Agents (Concordium Trusted Agents Hackathon, testnet demo — not a production payment product). Purchases metered micro-services from badge-verified seller agents, deposits the order amount into escrow, records deliveries in a hash-chained audit log, and settles only the net amount once via x402. Refuses to trade with agents whose Verified by Concordium badge does not verify.
name: NeuralClear Buyer Agent

skills.description: Opens an order with a badge-verified seller agent and deposits the order amount into the NeuralClear escrow ledger (testnet CCD).
skills.name: Place order

skills.description: Checks a delivery against the hash-chained audit log and confirms it, making the corresponding micro-obligation eligible for netting.
skills.name: Confirm delivery

skills.description: Asks the settlement engine to net all confirmed micro-obligations with a counterparty and settle the single net amount via x402, receiving an Ed25519-signed receipt.
skills.name: Request net settlement
